meaning.en: To eradicate something entirely, root and all, so it cannot return.
meaning.zh: 除草时连根拔掉，比喻彻底消灭，不留后患。

examples.zh: 要解决这个问题，必须斩草除根。
examples.en: To solve this problem we must root it out completely.

examples.zh: 政府决心对走私斩草除根。
examples.en: The government is determined to stamp out smuggling for good.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral when about pests or evils, harsh when about people.
usage.zh: 作谓语；用于害虫、弊端时为中性，用于人时语气狠毒。

antonyms: 凡事留一线，日后好相见

meaning.en: Something that passes quickly and leaves no lasting trace.
meaning.zh: 从眼前飘过的云烟，比喻很快消失、不值得留恋的事物。

examples.zh: 名利不过是过眼云烟。
examples.en: Fame and fortune are only passing clouds.

examples.zh: 往事如过眼云烟，不必再提。
examples.en: The past has drifted away like smoke; there's no need to raise it again.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 如过眼云烟.
usage.zh: 作谓语、宾语，常说“如过眼云烟”。

meaning.en: To give money to help someone in need.
meaning.zh: 拿出钱来帮助别人。

examples.zh: 灾情发生后，许多市民解囊相助。
examples.en: After the disaster, many citizens gave generously.

examples.zh: 同学们纷纷解囊相助，帮他渡过难关。
examples.en: His classmates chipped in to help him through the crisis.

meaning.en: To act a part so well, or for so long, that it becomes real.
meaning.zh: 本是演戏，却当作真事来做，也指表演时动了真感情。

equivalents: the act turns into the real thing

examples.zh: 两位演员拍戏时假戏真做，真的结婚了。
examples.en: The two actors fell for each other while filming and actually married.

examples.zh: 本来只是做做样子，结果假戏真做。
examples.en: It was meant to be for show but turned into the real thing.

meaning.en: To give up one's life for a just cause.
meaning.zh: 为了正义的事业而不惜牺牲生命。

equivalents: lay down one's life for a cause

examples.zh: 烈士们舍生取义，令人敬仰。
examples.en: The martyrs gave their lives for righteousness and are deeply revered.

examples.zh: 面对歹徒，他舍生取义，挺身而出。
examples.en: Facing the thugs, he stepped forward, risking his life for what was right.

story.en: Mencius: 'I want life and I want righteousness; if I cannot have both, I give up life and choose righteousness' (舍生而取义者也).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“生亦我所欲也，义亦我所欲也，二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也。”

synonyms: 不有行者，无以图将来；不有死者，无以召后起
生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也

literal: scoop up · hot water · stop · boiling
natural: ladle the boiling water to stop it boiling

meaning.en: To treat only the symptom, not the cause.
meaning.zh: 把锅里的开水舀起来再倒回去想让它不沸，比喻不从根本上解决问题。

equivalents: treat the symptom, not the cause

examples.zh: 单靠补贴稳价，无异于扬汤止沸。
examples.en: Propping up prices with subsidies alone is merely treating the symptom.

examples.zh: 这种临时措施只是扬汤止沸。
examples.en: Such temporary measures are only a stopgap.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 釜底抽薪.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常与“釜底抽薪”对举。

natural: cling to a last gasp of life

meaning.en: To hang on with a last bit of life or strength.
meaning.zh: 勉强拖延一口没有断的气，比喻勉强维持生存。

examples.zh: 这家老店在连年亏损中苟延残喘。
examples.en: The old shop limped on through years of losses.

examples.zh: 敌军只能苟延残喘，不久就会覆灭。
examples.en: The enemy can only cling on and will soon be finished.

meaning.en: Brightly coloured and eye-catching.
meaning.zh: 色彩鲜明艳丽，非常引人注目。

examples.zh: 花园里的玫瑰鲜艳夺目。
examples.en: The roses in the garden are dazzlingly bright.

examples.zh: 她穿着一件鲜艳夺目的红裙。
examples.en: She wore an eye-catching red dress.

meaning.en: Devoid of interest or flavour.
meaning.zh: 毫无兴味，枯燥乏味。

examples.zh: 这场比赛节奏拖沓，看得人索然无味。
examples.en: The match dragged and left viewers bored.

examples.zh: 没有朋友一起吃饭，再好的菜也索然无味。
examples.en: Without friends to share it, even the best food is tasteless.

meaning.en: To lose all dignity or reputation.
meaning.zh: 脸面丢尽，名誉全无。

examples.zh: 丑闻曝光后，他颜面扫地。
examples.en: After the scandal broke, he lost all face.

examples.zh: 输给了一支业余队，球队颜面扫地。
examples.en: Losing to an amateur side left the team deeply embarrassed.

meaning.en: To stand by and watch others fight without helping.
meaning.zh: 在营垒上看别人作战，比喻置身事外，不予援助。

examples.zh: 邻国遭难，我们不能作壁上观。
examples.en: We can't stand idly by while a neighbour is in trouble.

examples.zh: 同事之间争吵时，他总是作壁上观。
examples.en: When colleagues quarrel, he always watches from the sidelines.

story.en: At Julu, the other lords' armies watched from their ramparts as Chu fought Qin (诸侯军皆从壁上观).
story.zh: 《史记》：“及楚击秦，诸侯军救巨鹿下者十余壁，莫敢纵兵。……诸侯军皆从壁上观。”

natural: watch the fire from across the river

meaning.en: To watch others' troubles from a safe distance, without helping.
meaning.zh: 隔着河看对岸起火，比喻对别人的危难袖手旁观，也指坐等对方内乱。

equivalents: stand by and let others fight

examples.zh: 两家公司打价格战，他们却隔岸观火。
examples.en: The two firms are in a price war while they watch from a safe distance.

examples.zh: 遇到朋友有难，不能隔岸观火。
examples.en: When a friend is in trouble you can't just look on.

usage.en: Predicate; also the ninth of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
usage.zh: 作谓语；也是三十六计第九计。

story.en: The ninth of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, 'Watch the fire from across the river', advises waiting while the enemy's internal disorder ripens, then acting.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第九计“隔岸观火”：待敌方内部矛盾激化，我坐观其变，伺机而动。

date.en: late Ming to early Qing, 17th c.

natural: at a loss whether to advance or retreat

meaning.en: Left with no firm ground whether one advances or retreats.
meaning.zh: 前进后退都失去依据，形容处境尴尬，不知如何是好。

equivalents: at a loss what to do

examples.zh: 政策反复调整，企业进退失据。
examples.en: With policy changing repeatedly, firms are wrong-footed either way.

examples.zh: 他两头得罪，一时进退失据。
examples.en: Having offended both sides, he was left with nowhere to turn.

meaning.en: To have some family or personal tie, however distant.
meaning.zh: 有亲戚或老关系，多指关系不算近。

examples.zh: 村里人大多沾亲带故。
examples.en: Most people in the village are related in some way.

examples.zh: 沾亲带故也不能搞特殊。
examples.en: Being related is no excuse for special treatment.

usage.en: Predicate; negated form 不沾亲不带故 is common.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“不沾亲不带故”。

meaning.en: No different; exactly alike.
meaning.zh: 没有两样，完全一样。

examples.zh: 这款新机型与旧款别无二致。
examples.en: The new model is no different from the old one.

examples.zh: 他的做法与骗子别无二致。
examples.en: His methods are no different from a fraudster's.

meaning.en: To acknowledge one's ancestors and rejoin the family line.
meaning.zh: 承认祖先，回归本家。

examples.zh: 多年后，他回到老家认祖归宗。
examples.en: Years later he returned to his home village to reclaim his roots.

examples.zh: 海外华人常回乡寻根，认祖归宗。
examples.en: Overseas Chinese often come home to trace their ancestry.

meaning.en: Full of interest and enthusiasm.
meaning.zh: 兴趣十分浓厚。

examples.zh: 孩子们对实验兴趣盎然。
examples.en: The children are keenly interested in the experiment.

examples.zh: 他兴趣盎然地翻看着旧照片。
examples.en: He leafed through the old photos with great interest.

meaning.en: To drink freely and happily.
meaning.zh: 敞开心怀，痛痛快快地喝酒。

examples.zh: 老友重逢，大家开怀畅饮。
examples.en: The old friends reunited and drank to their hearts' content.

examples.zh: 今晚不醉不归，让我们开怀畅饮！
examples.en: Tonight we drink till we drop, so let's drink freely!

usage.zh: 作谓语，多用于欢庆场合。

meaning.en: In complete disarray, as if men and horses were tumbling over.
meaning.zh: 人和马都被打得东倒西歪，形容混乱不堪或惨败。

examples.zh: 孩子们一闹，家里被弄得人仰马翻。
examples.en: The children's antics turned the house upside down.

examples.zh: 双十一大促让客服忙得人仰马翻。
examples.en: The shopping festival has the customer service team run off their feet.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often 闹得/忙得人仰马翻.
usage.zh: 作谓语、补语，常说“闹得、忙得人仰马翻”。

meaning.en: Not letting personal relationships bend one's judgment.
meaning.zh: 不因私人感情而偏袒、违反原则。

examples.zh: 法官不徇私情，依法判决。
examples.en: The judge ruled by law without favouritism.

examples.zh: 老师批改作业不徇私情，一视同仁。
examples.en: The teacher marks without bias and treats everyone alike.

meaning.en: To apply make-up, or to gloss over something ugly with a pleasant surface.
meaning.zh: 往脸上涂胭脂抹粉，也比喻粉饰、掩盖丑恶的本质。

examples.zh: 她每天早上都要涂脂抹粉一番。
examples.en: She spends time putting on her make-up every morning.

examples.zh: 再怎么涂脂抹粉，也掩盖不了事实。
examples.en: However much you gloss over it, you can't hide the truth.

usage.zh: 作谓语，可指化妆，也可作比喻。

meaning.en: Sensible and considerate of others' feelings.
meaning.zh: 说话做事讲道理，体谅别人。

examples.zh: 他妈妈很通情达理，从不勉强孩子。
examples.en: His mother is very reasonable and never forces the children.

examples.zh: 请各位通情达理，多多包涵。
examples.en: Please be understanding and bear with us.

antonyms: 茅坑里的石头——又臭又硬
